Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 33% of the way down her figure from the top, about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries applied 24K YELLOW GOLD metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright 24K YELLOW GOLD sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied ROSE-GOLD metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright ROSE-GOLD sheen filling every gap. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied RUBY RED metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright RUBY RED sheen filling every gap. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries applied EMERALD GREEN metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright EMERALD GREEN sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
